candidate_workaround: Run the native ancestry command first, capture its exit code in a scalar, then construct the PowerShell object.
failure_signature: A semicolon-bearing native command was embedded inside a PowerShell hash-literal expression and produced a missing-parenthesis parser error.
recurrence_guard: Do not embed native commands with statement separators inside hash-literal value expressions.
rollback: Use one scalar probe per command and stop without mutation if any exit code is nonzero.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local PowerShell and Git evidence only.
title: Capture native exit codes before PowerShell object construction
trigger_preconditions: native command success must be included in a structured receipt
